baseline_models.focus_anchor: The trusted addressees, the question of indication, the trade, causative rescue, and painful punishment form one offer.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trust gives the invitation relational credit, indication supplies a knowable sign, and commerce supplies risk and gain; the gain is not an acquired object but separation from a punitive condition that causes pain.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the credit on which the offered transaction can be heard.
Indication by a sign makes the offer evidentiary rather than a bare imperative.
Profit-seeking trade supplies the governing exchange and return structure.
Deliverance by separation defines the transaction's non-possessive profit.
Punitive torment names the condition from which the return separates the addressees.
Pain-causing force makes the threatened loss experiential, not merely juridical.

changed_reading.before: A religious bargain promises reward and escape from punishment.
changed_reading.after: A trusted, sign-readable transaction offers profit as being separated from an actively pain-causing punitive state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction of being directed toward a trade joins indication, destination, expertise, swift movement, and elevated separation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The trade can be read as a navigable gainful route: a sign points toward a destination, expertise supplies the method, and rescue is rapid movement onto separated high ground. Commerce and spatial passage coexist rather than cancel each other.

activation_trace.role: A route-revealing sign supplies orientation toward the offered course.
A trade-place or destination turns commerce into somewhere one is directed.
Expertise in a gainful way makes the route a practiced method rather than a slogan.
Swift going supplies urgency and motion through the route.
High separated ground supplies the route's spatial image of safety.

changed_reading.before: Trade is a free-standing financial metaphor.
changed_reading.after: Trade is also a marked route and learned gainful practice whose destination is rapid separation onto safe high ground.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of trade, causative rescue, punishment, and pain permits an extraction model inside the focus wording.
baseline_models.mechanism: One live branch makes rescue a stripping-out and another makes punishment withholding or weaning. The transaction may therefore profit by extracting the person from an attachment and weaning them from a regime that culminates in pain.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking trade frames detachment as a costly but gainful conversion.
Stripping and extracting supplies the mechanics of rescue from an enclosing regime.
Withholding and weaning recasts punishment as a binding deprivation from which one must detach.
Aching is the embodied endpoint that makes extraction necessary.

changed_reading.before: Rescue means only exemption from a later sentence.
changed_reading.after: Rescue may begin as present extraction and weaning from a painful economy of attachment and deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trade metaphor acquires a credit test: emitted claims must settle as enacted work, and isolated actors must become aligned, joined, and tightened into a load-bearing whole. The transaction converts assent into executable collective performance.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking exchange provides the credit and settlement frame.
Issued speech supplies the claim whose backing is being tested.
Brought-about action supplies performance that can settle the verbal claim.
Alignment on one line makes performance coordinated rather than private.
Joining parts into a construction makes each performed commitment support the others.
Tight consolidation supplies the final condition of collective solvency.

structural_cues: 61:2-3 repeats the mismatch between saying and doing before 61:4 replaces mismatch with a fitted formation.
The same believer-address in 61:2 returns at the trade question in 61:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, nonperformance, alignment, joining, and tightening; I infer that these function as credit and settlement conditions inside the later trade image. A live alternative is that they remain moral and martial examples without transactional force.

changed_reading.before: Belief and sacrifice purchase rescue in a generic exchange.
changed_reading.after: The offered trade first tests whether trusted speech has executable backing and then consolidates that performance into a solvent collective body.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rescue by separation moves upstream from final punishment to a feedback process: an initial deviation is followed by reversal of the heart, after which disclosed signs can be misrecognized. Indication in 61:10 becomes an intervention in perception before the reversal stabilizes.

activation_trace.role: Sign-based indication supplies a countermeasure to failed recognition.
Separation defines rescue as interruption of the developing feedback loop.
Departure from straightness supplies the initiating movement and its repeated consequence.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the internal reversal that follows deviation.
Gentle direction toward a road supplies the unrealized alternative trajectory.
Disclosure and emergence sharpen the puzzle of signs being present yet misread.

structural_cues: 61:5 explicitly sequences their deviation before the turning of their hearts.
61:6-7 places disclosed signs and an invitation beside accusations of magic and fabrication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequenced deviation, heart-reversal, guidance, and disclosed signs; I infer a self-reinforcing perceptual process that the focus indication interrupts. The alternative is a purely judicial sequence with no cognitive-feedback emphasis.

changed_reading.before: The trade removes believers from an external future punishment.
changed_reading.after: The trade also separates them from the earlier deviation-to-reversal process that makes saving signs unreadable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of the invitation to islam names an advance-payment sale, while din contributes debt and reckoning. With present commitments specified in 61:11 and later delivery in 61:12, the focus trade can behave like a forward-settled covenant rather than a loose metaphor.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking trade anchors the contract analogy directly in the focus.
A sale paid in advance supplies the structure of present surrender for deferred delivery.
Financial debt supplies an obligation carried until settlement.
Accounting and recompense supply the eventual balancing of the transaction.

structural_cues: The call to islam in 61:7 and true din in 61:9 immediately precede the trade offer.
The offer is followed by present commitments in 61:11 and promised outcomes in 61:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an advance-sale branch, debt, reckoning, and a present-to-later sequence; I map them onto a forward contract without claiming that the verse names a technical legal form. The live alternative is ordinary surrender and religion with no contract specificity.

changed_reading.before: Trade is an unspecified exchange of obedience for reward.
changed_reading.after: Trade can be carried as a forward-settled covenant: committed capital is due now, while rescue and dwelling mature later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offer to indicate a trade follows attempted verbal extinguishing, unstoppable completion of light, and promised manifestation. The transaction therefore becomes a public demonstration: its enacted form is itself a visible marker that hostile speech cannot suppress.

activation_trace.role: Indication by a sign anchors the focus as an invitation to inspect evidence.
A conspicuous beacon supplies the public visibility that speech tries to erase.
Arrival at completion prevents hostile interruption from defining the outcome.
Emergence into view makes the transaction's effects publicly legible.

structural_cues: 61:8 opposes mouths to a light that will be completed.
61:9 promises manifestation immediately before 61:10 asks whether the addressees will be shown a trade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted verbal suppression, visible light, completion, and manifestation; I infer that the enacted trade participates as demonstrative evidence. The alternative confines all visibility to the divine message and gives the participants no sign-bearing role.

changed_reading.before: The question privately informs believers about a bargain.
changed_reading.after: The question recruits them into a transaction whose enacted completion becomes public evidence against verbal suppression.

context_deltas.mechanism: 61:11 identifies the trade's inputs: accumulated property and the precious living self enter strenuous use. The gainful skill of the focus is thus capital conversion, moving stored and cherished resources into a demanding course that consumes capacity rather than preserving inventory.

activation_trace.role: Expertise in a gainful way makes the commanded expenditures a disciplined capital strategy.
Exerting full capacity under hardship supplies the transaction's costly work.
Depletion through use makes expenditure materially consequential rather than symbolic.
Accumulated property supplies stored capital that must be put into motion.
A precious object over which selves compete marks the self as the most guarded capital.
The life-bearing self makes the transaction existential as well as financial.

structural_cues: 61:11 directly answers the trade question with coordinated predicates and instrumental phrases for property and selves.
The focus promises rescue before the inputs are disclosed, so the disclosure changes what the reader counts as capital.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies strenuous expenditure, depletion by use, accumulated property, and the precious living self; I assign these the role of risk capital because 61:11 grammatically unpacks the trade. The alternative treats them only as instruments of striving, not transactional inputs.

changed_reading.before: The trade asks for belief plus an undefined sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: The trade converts accumulated property and the guarded living self into risk capital through capacity-depleting action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised return is staged rather than singular: prior liabilities are covered, the trader crosses an admission threshold, reaches a protected garden, receives continuing provision, and gains settled residence after a dangerous passage. Rescue becomes a full liability-to-settlement transformation.

activation_trace.role: Deliverance by separation anchors the negative first movement of settlement.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer supplies liability clearance and protection from residue.
Entry into an interior supplies the threshold after clearance.
A garden concealed by growth supplies a protected destination rather than mere open escape.
Continuing provision turns the return into recurring yield.
A place of stable settlement converts transit into durable residence.
A wilderness poised between escape and destruction preserves the risk at the settlement threshold.

structural_cues: 61:12 sequences covering, entering, flowing provision, dwelling, and victory as consequences of 61:11.
The negative rescue promised in 61:10 is followed by several positive forms of return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a consequence sequence of covering, entry, protected growth, continued provision, residence, and a risky victory-threshold; I read that sequence as staged settlement. The alternative is a nonfunctional list of independent rewards.

changed_reading.before: The transaction pays one return: avoidance of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The transaction clears liabilities, crosses a threshold, establishes protected recurring provision, and settles the trader beyond a still-remembered zone of risk.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the protected settlement of 61:12, 61:13 names another loved outcome and marks it as near: support and an opening that begins what follows. The trade therefore carries two noncollapsed maturity horizons, deferred settlement and nearer enabling return.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking exchange makes distinct returns readable as maturities of one transaction.
Another outcome after or besides the first prevents the promised returns from being collapsed.
Aid that makes its recipient manifest supplies the nearer operational return.
An opening beginning what comes after makes the near return enabling rather than terminal.
Temporal nearness distinguishes this maturity from the preceding settled destination.

structural_cues: 61:13 begins with another outcome after the extended return described in 61:12.
The second outcome is affectively marked as loved and temporally marked as near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a first return sequence, another loved outcome, support, an opening, and nearness; I infer two maturity horizons inside the trade. The alternative treats the near outcome as an independent gift rather than a return on the same offer.

changed_reading.before: The trade has one deferred payoff beyond the present world.
changed_reading.after: The trade holds deferred settlement and a nearer enabling return together without reducing either to the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated address to believers turns customers into helpers inside a cooperative body. Dialogic supporters, wrapped groups, strengthening, and collective emergence show that the trade's rescued 'you' is formed through participation in a network of aid, not only through an individual bargain.

activation_trace.role: Shared trusting assent anchors the addressees as a body capable of coordinated commitment.
Trade supplies the relation whose participants are reclassified from recipients to contributors.
Aid and making another manifest supply the cooperative function repeatedly assigned to the group.
The supporter branch gives the exemplary respondents a role inside the aid network.
A group wrapped together supplies bounded collective formation on both sides of the response.
Confirming strength supplies the support that converts commitment into collective capacity.
Collective ascendancy supplies the visible outcome of the aid network.

structural_cues: 61:14 repeats the believer-address of 61:10 and immediately commands a helper identity.
The example is dialogic, divides people into groups, and ends with the strengthening and emergence of one group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated address, helper roles, grouped response, strengthening, and emergence; I infer that these disclose the social form of the trade's plural rescue. The alternative keeps 61:14 as a separate exhortation with no effect on the transactional model.

changed_reading.before: Each believer enters an individual bargain for personal rescue.
changed_reading.after: The bargain incorporates believers into a reciprocal aid body whose collective strengthening is part of how rescue becomes visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped root behind the repeated speech cue, where speech activates scarcity rather than ordinary saying. It remains anchored in the focus trade and the explicit saying-doing contrast, but downstream prose should label it a split-root pressure on the metaphor, not a lexical translation of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The trade in 61:10 can price the verbal claims made by the same addressed believers in 61:2.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking trade supplies a frame in which speech can be valued as capital.
Scarcity and paltriness make unperformed speech read as undercapitalized value.
Enacted work supplies the missing backing that can raise the claim's value.

changed_reading.before: The opening rebuke concerns hypocrisy, while the trade is a later independent metaphor.
changed_reading.after: The trade may expose unperformed speech as scarce capital whose value exists only when action backs it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the will to extinguish activates a non-dominant mapped root whose branch concerns returning goods in a sale. It remains anchored by the focus trade and the immediate 61:8-10 sequence, but it should be rendered only as an adversarial rescission analogy, never as the direct sense of the context verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus trade follows an attempted interruption that is denied by completion.

activation_trace.role: Trade anchors the possibility of acceptance, rejection, or attempted cancellation.
Restitution and returning goods in a sale supplies the hostile rescission image.
Completion blocks the attempted return from cancelling the larger transaction.

changed_reading.before: Opponents merely try to suppress a message before believers receive a separate offer.
changed_reading.after: Their suppression can be carried as an attempted rescission of a transaction whose completion is not theirs to cancel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the punishment root also carries fresh sweetness, and later flowing water and pleasant dwelling reactivate that suppressed pole. The contrast remains anchored in the focus's punishment and pain plus 61:12's material outcome, but prose should present it as a root-internal sensory reversal, not replace the clear punitive sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The painful punishment in 61:10 contains a branch polarity that the promised environment of 61:12 can reverse.

activation_trace.role: Punitive torment supplies the explicit negative pole in the focus.
Fresh sweet palatability supplies the root-internal counter-pole held latent by the punitive usage.
Pain-causing force sharpens the sensory negativity to be reversed.
Flowing water cutting through land materializes the fresh-water side of the reversal.
The self finding something pleasant supplies affective arrival at the positive pole.

changed_reading.before: Rescue moves from punishment to an unrelated reward environment.
changed_reading.after: Rescue can also be felt as a root-internal reversal from pain-bearing punishment to restored sweetness, flow, and felt pleasantness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because one victory branch names death or destruction and another places victory in the wilderness between escape and ruin. It remains anchored in the focus's trade and rescue and in 61:11-12's living self and victory, but downstream prose must keep it as a lexical inversion of ordinary profit, not assert that death is the promised outcome.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A trade promising rescue can still expose the trader's ordinary definitions of profit, loss, life, and victory to reversal.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking trade supplies the conventional gain-loss scale that is destabilized.
Deliverance by separation anchors victory to rescue even while the cost remains live.
The life-bearing self identifies what can appear to be irrecoverable capital.
A victory branch naming death or destruction reverses the ordinary accounting of loss.
The wilderness between rescue and ruin keeps both outcomes at the threshold of victory.

changed_reading.before: Successful trade preserves the self and avoids every form of loss.
changed_reading.after: The trade can invert ordinary accounting: expenditure of the living self may look like terminal loss while the text's victory field still holds rescue and ruin at one threshold.

strongest_changes: The trade became a credit-and-performance test in which speech requires enacted collective backing.
The islam and din branches activated a forward-settled contract with present capital and deferred delivery.
Property and the living self became risk capital converted through strenuous, capacity-consuming use.
The promised return expanded into liability coverage, admission, recurring provision, stable residence, and two maturity horizons.
The final believer-address changed personal rescue into participation in a strengthened cooperative body.
summary.what_was_special: Focus-only branches already supported transaction, route, extraction, and weaning models; context then activated executable credit, perceptual rescue, public proof, layered settlement, temporal bifurcation, and collective incorporation. Non-dominant mapped roots preserved the stranger possibilities of scarce speech and attempted trade rescission, while punishment and victory branch polarities preserved sensory and gain-loss reversals.
remaining_uncertainties: The advance-sale structure is branch-backed and sequentially apt, but its technical contract specificity remains analogical.
The deviation-to-heart-reversal sequence supports a feedback model, though a purely judicial reading remains live.
The death-bearing victory and rescission readings depend on distant or non-dominant branches and require explicit exploratory qualification.
The individual and collective transaction models coexist; the packet does not force either to absorb the other.
